en.t: Theophilos becomes sole Byzantine emperor after Michael II’s death
en.s: On October 2, 829, Theophilos succeeded his father Michael II as sole Byzantine emperor. He had already served as co-emperor since 821.
en.n: This was the start of his sole rule, rather than his earlier appointment as co-emperor. The historical date has not been converted to the modern Gregorian calendar.

zh.t: 狄奥斐洛在父亲去世后成为拜占庭唯一皇帝
zh.s: 829年10月2日，米海尔二世去世后，其子狄奥斐洛成为拜占庭唯一的皇帝。狄奥斐洛自821年起已担任共治皇帝。
zh.n: 这里记录开始单独统治的日期，并非此前受封共治皇帝的日期。历史日期未换算为现代公历。

en.s: The Battle of Andernach, between the followers and the opponents of King Otto I of Germany, took place on 2 October 939 in Andernach on the Rhine river and ended with a decisive defeat of the rebels and the death of their leaders. Duke Eberhard of Franconia, a scion of the Conradine dynasty, had been a loyal supporter of the Liudolfing king Henry I of Germany (919–936).

zh.s: 939年10月2日，德意志国王奥托一世的拥护者与反对者在莱茵河畔安德纳赫交战。叛军遭到决定性击败，首领阵亡。法兰克尼亚公爵埃伯哈德是康拉丁王朝成员，曾忠实拥护柳多尔芬王朝的德意志国王亨利一世（919—936年）。

en.s: The siege of Jerusalem lasted from 20 September to 2 October 1187, when Balian of Ibelin surrendered the city to the forces of the Ayyubid Sultanate under sultan Saladin. Earlier that summer, Egyptian forces under Saladin had defeated the kingdom's army and conquered several cities. Balian was charged with organizing a defense. The city was full of refugees but had few soldiers.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 耶路撒冷围城战持续于1187年9月20日至10月2日，伊贝林的巴里安将该城交给萨拉丁领导的阿尤布王朝军队。那年夏天，萨拉丁率领的埃及军队击败耶路撒冷王国军队并攻占数座城市。巴里安受命组织防御。当时城内挤满难民，但守军很少。

en.s: The Battle of Largs (2 October 1263) was an indecisive engagement between the kingdoms of Norway and Scotland near Largs, Scotland. The conflict formed part of the Norwegian expedition against Scotland in 1263, in which Haakon Haakonarson, King of Norway attempted to reassert Norwegian sovereignty over the western seaboard of Scotland. Since the beginning of the 12th century this region had lain within the Norwegian realm, ruled by magnates who recognised the overlordship of the Kings of Norway. However, in the mid-13th century, two Scottish kings, Alexander II and his son Alexander III, attempted to incorporate the region into their own realm.

zh.s: 拉格斯战役发生于1263年10月2日，是挪威与苏格兰王国在苏格兰拉格斯附近进行的一场未分胜负的交战。该战是1263年挪威远征苏格兰的一部分。当时挪威国王哈康四世·哈康松试图重申对苏格兰西部沿海地区的主权。自12世纪初以来，该地区一直属于挪威王国，由承认挪威国王宗主权的权贵统治。13世纪中叶，苏格兰国王亚历山大二世及其子亚历山大三世试图将该地区纳入苏格兰王国。

en.s: The siege of Zierikzee (1351) took place during the first of the Hook and Cod wars.

zh.s: 1351年的泽里克泽围城战发生在胡克派与鳕鱼派战争的第一阶段。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的事件结束日期。

en.s: An Anglo-Gascon force under Edward, the Black Prince, conducted a large-scale chevauchée (mounted raid) between 4 August and 2 October 1356 as a part of the Hundred Years' War. The war had broken out in 1337, but a truce and the ravages of the Black Death had restricted the extent of the fighting since 1347. By 1355 the French king, John II, was determined to resume full-scale war.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 百年战争期间，黑太子爱德华率领一支英格兰—加斯科涅军队，于1356年8月4日至10月2日展开大规模骑行劫掠。百年战争于1337年爆发，但1347年以来的停战和黑死病肆虐限制了战事规模。到1355年，法国国王约翰二世决心恢复全面战争。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Kruševac was fought on October 2, 1454 between the forces of the Serbian Despotate, allied with the Kingdom of Hungary, and the Ottoman Empire. In 1454 the Ottomans launched a major invasion against Serbia, at the helm of which was the Sultan himself, Mehmed the Conqueror. On the Morava River, sultan Mehmed II left Firuz Bey and 32,000 of his troops to resist any possible counterattacks by the Serbs. The Serbs did not hesitate to make the first move and the two armies met. The battle allowed John Hunyadi and the Serbs to launch a major offensive against the Turks, ravaging Niš and Pirot, and burning down Vidin.

zh.s: 1454年10月2日，塞尔维亚专制国与匈牙利王国结盟，对阵奥斯曼帝国，在克鲁舍瓦茨交战。1454年，穆罕默德二世亲自率奥斯曼军队大举入侵塞尔维亚。他在摩拉瓦河留下菲鲁兹贝伊和3.2万名士兵，以防塞尔维亚人反击。塞军主动出击，双方随即交战。此役之后，匈雅提·亚诺什和塞尔维亚人得以对奥斯曼人发动大规模攻势，蹂躏尼什和皮罗特，并焚毁维丁。

en.t: Edward IV sails from England into exile
en.s: On October 2, 1470, Edward IV sailed from England into exile during the rebellion led by the Earl of Warwick. He took refuge in the lands of the Duke of Burgundy.
en.n: This records Edward’s departure, rather than Henry VI’s restoration.

zh.t: 爱德华四世乘船离开英格兰流亡
zh.s: 1470年10月2日，沃里克伯爵领导的叛乱期间，爱德华四世乘船离开英格兰，逃到勃艮第公爵领地避难。
zh.n: 这里记录爱德华四世离境，并非亨利六世复位。

en.s: The Battle of Sauðafell (Orrustan á Sauðafelli) occurred in 1550, when the forces of Catholic Bishop Jón Arason clashed with the forces of Daði Guðmundsson of Snóksdalur.

zh.s: 绍达费尔战役（冰岛语：Orrustan á Sauðafelli）发生于1550年，天主教主教约恩·阿拉松的部队与斯诺克斯达尔的达迪·古德蒙松的部队交战。

en.s: The Siege of Kazan, also known as the Fall of Kazan, was the decisive military campaign of the Russo-Kazan Wars in 1552 that resulted in the capture of Kazan and the annexation of the Khanate of Kazan by the Tsardom of Russia. The siege began on 23 August 1552 and ended with the capture of the city on 2 October.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 喀山围城战又称喀山陷落，是1552年俄喀战争中的决定性军事行动，最终俄军攻占喀山并吞并喀山汗国。围城于1552年8月23日开始，10月2日俄军攻占该城，围城战结束。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Spanish Fury at Mechelen (Dutch: Spaanse Furie in Mechelen) was an event in the Eighty Years' War on October 2, 1572 in which the city of Mechelen was conquered by the Spanish army and brutally sacked.

zh.s: 梅赫伦西班牙暴行（荷兰语：Spaanse Furie in Mechelen）是八十年战争期间发生的一起事件。1572年10月2日，西班牙军队攻占比利时梅赫伦，并对该城大肆洗劫。

en.s: The siege of Kinsale (Irish: Léigear Chionn tSáile), also known as the battle of Kinsale, was the ultimate battle in England's conquest of Gaelic Ireland, commencing in October 1601, near the end of the reign of Queen Elizabeth I, and at the climax of the Nine Years' War—a campaign by Hugh O'Neill, Hugh Roe O'Donnell and other Irish lords against English rule.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 金塞尔围城战（爱尔兰语：Léigear Chionn tSáile）又称金塞尔战役，是英格兰征服盖尔爱尔兰的最后一场战役。战事于1601年10月在金塞尔附近开始，当时正值伊丽莎白一世统治末期，也是九年战争的关键阶段。九年战争是休·奥尼尔、休·罗·奥唐奈及其他爱尔兰领主反抗英国统治的一场战争。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的事件开始日期。

en.s: The raid on the Kerkennah Islands of 1611 was a naval attack by Spanish commander Álvaro de Bazán y Benavides against the Kerkennah Islands, in Ottoman Tunisia. It resulted in a victory of the Spanish and its Italian allies over the local Ottomans and Barbary corsairs.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1611年，西班牙指挥官阿尔瓦罗·德·巴赞·伊·贝纳维德斯对奥斯曼帝国突尼斯境内的克肯纳群岛发动海上袭击。西班牙及其意大利盟友战胜了当地的奥斯曼军队和巴巴里海盗。

en.s: The Chongzhen Emperor (6 February 1611 – 25 April 1644), temple name Ming Sizong, personal name Zhu Youjian, courtesy name Deyue, was the 17th and last emperor of the Ming dynasty, reigning from 1627 to 1644. He succeeded his elder brother, the Tianqi Emperor. "Chongzhen", the era name of his reign, means "honorable and auspicious." Zhu Youjian was son of the Taichang Emperor.

zh.s: 崇祯帝朱由检（1611年2月6日—1644年4月25日），庙号明思宗，是明朝第十七位、也是最后一位皇帝，1627年至1644年在位。他在兄长天启帝之后继位。崇祯是他的年号，意为尊贵而吉祥。朱由检是泰昌帝之子。

en.s: The Capture of Delhi took place in 1788 between the forces of Ghulam Qadir Rohilla supported by Mirza Ismail Beg, and the Marathas under Mahadji Shinde on behalf of Shah Alam II who desired the execution of Ghulam Kadir. Mahadji Shinde became successful and executed Kadir after the battle.

zh.s: 1788年，古拉姆·卡迪尔·罗希拉在米尔扎·伊斯梅尔·贝格支持下，与马拉塔军队交战，试图攻占德里。马拉塔军由马哈吉·辛迪亚代表沙阿·阿拉姆二世指挥，沙阿·阿拉姆二世希望处决古拉姆·卡迪尔。马哈吉·辛迪亚最终获胜，并在战后处决了卡迪尔。

en.s: The 1792 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on October 2, 1792. It was the first popular gubernatorial election following ratification of the Delaware Constitution of 1792. The Federalist incumbent president of Delaware Joshua Clayton defeated the Anti-Federalist former delegate to the Delaware constitutional convention Thomas Montgomery and the Anti-Federalist councilor George Mitchell.

zh.s: 1792年10月2日，特拉华州举行州长选举，这是1792年《特拉华州宪法》获批准后的首次州长普选。联邦党籍特拉华州现任总统约书亚·克莱顿击败反联邦党候选人、前州制宪会议代表托马斯·蒙哥马利和反联邦党州议员乔治·米切尔。

en.s: The Battle of Aldenhoven or Battle of the Roer (2 October 1794) saw a Republican French army commanded by Jean Baptiste Jourdan attack a Habsburg Austrian army under François Sébastien Charles Joseph de Croix, Count of Clerfayt which was defending the line of the Roer River. The key crossing was won by the French right wing at Düren after heavy fighting. The Austrian retreat from the Roer conceded control of the west bank of the Rhine River to France. The battle occurred during the War of the First Coalition, part of a wider conflict called the Wars of the French Revolution.

zh.s: 奥尔登霍芬战役又称鲁尔河战役，发生于1794年10月2日。让-巴蒂斯特·茹尔当指挥的法兰西共和国军队进攻弗朗索瓦-塞巴斯蒂安-夏尔-约瑟夫·德·克鲁瓦（克莱费伯爵）率领的哈布斯堡奥军，后者正沿鲁尔河防线布防。经过激战，法军右翼在迪伦攻下关键渡口。奥军撤离鲁尔河，使法国控制了莱茵河西岸。此役发生于第一次反法同盟战争期间，该战争属于更广泛的法国大革命战争。

en.s: Battle of Bydgoszcz took place on 2 October 1794 during the Kościuszko Uprising. It involved Polish–Lithuanian forces led by Jan Henryk Dąbrowski against Prussia led by Johann Friedrich Székely. It ended with a Polish–Lithuanian victory.

zh.s: 比得哥什战役发生于1794年10月2日，是科希丘什科起义期间的一场战斗。扬·亨利克·东布罗夫斯基率领波兰—立陶宛军队对抗约翰·弗里德里希·塞凯伊指挥的普鲁士军队，最终波兰—立陶宛获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Biberach was fought on 2 October 1796 between a First French Republic army led by Jean Victor Marie Moreau and a Habsburg Austrian army led by Maximilian Anton Karl, Count Baillet de Latour. The French army paused in its retreat toward the Rhine River to savage the pursuing Austrians. The action occurred during the War of the First Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars. Biberach an der Riss is located 35 kilometres (22 mi) southwest of Ulm. During the summer of 1796, the two armies of Jean-Baptiste Jourdan in the north and Moreau in the south advanced into southern Germany.

zh.s: 1796年10月2日，若望-维克托-马里·莫罗率领的法兰西第一共和国军队与马克西米连·安东·卡尔·巴耶·德·拉图尔伯爵率领的哈布斯堡奥军在比伯拉赫交战。法军在撤向莱茵河途中停下，猛烈反击追击中的奥军。此役发生于第一次反法同盟战争期间，属于法国大革命战争的一部分。比伯拉赫河畔比伯拉赫位于乌尔姆西南35公里（22英里）。1796年夏，茹尔当和莫罗分别率军从北、南两路推进到德国南部。

en.t: 1798 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
en.s: The 1798 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware was held on October 2, 1798. The incumbent Representative James A. Bayard Sr. won reelection.

zh.t: 1798年特拉华州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1798年10月2日，特拉华州举行联邦众议院选举。时任众议员詹姆斯·A·贝亚德成功连任。

en.s: The 1798 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on October 2, 1798. The Federalist chief justice of the Delaware Court of Common Pleas Richard Bassett defeated the Democratic-Republican candidate David Hall.

zh.s: 1798年10月2日，特拉华州举行州长选举。联邦党候选人、特拉华州普通诉讼法院首席大法官理查德·巴塞特击败民主共和党候选人大卫·霍尔。

en.s: The Battle of Alkmaar (also sometimes called the Second Battle of Bergen or the Battle of Egmond-aan-Zee) was fought on 2 October 1799 between forces of the French Republic and her ally, the Batavian Republic under the command of general Guillaume Marie Anne Brune, and an expeditionary force from Great Britain and her ally Russia, commanded by Prince Frederick, Duke of York and Albany in the vicinity of Alkmaar during the Anglo-Russian Invasion of Holland. Though the battle ended in a tactical draw, the Anglo-Russians were in a position at the end of the battle that favored them slightly in a strategic sense.

zh.s: 阿尔克马尔战役有时也称第二次卑尔根战役或埃赫蒙德滨海战役，发生于1799年10月2日。法兰西共和国及其盟友巴达维亚共和国的军队由纪尧姆·马里·安妮·布吕纳将军指挥；英国及其盟友俄罗斯的远征军则由约克和奥尔巴尼公爵弗雷德里克亲王指挥。双方在英俄联军入侵荷兰期间于阿尔克马尔附近交战。战斗在战术上未分胜负，但英俄联军在战略上略占优势。

en.s: The 1804 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on October 2, 1804. The Federalist prothonotary from Sussex County Nathaniel Mitchell defeated the Democratic-Republican candidate Joseph Haslet.

zh.s: 1804年10月2日，特拉华州举行州长选举。联邦党候选人、苏塞克斯县法院书记官内森尼尔·米切尔击败民主共和党候选人约瑟夫·哈斯莱特。

en.s: The 1810 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on October 2, 1810. The Democratic-Republican candidate Joseph Haslet defeated the Federalist former judge of the Delaware Court of Common Pleas Daniel Rodney.

zh.s: 1810年10月2日，特拉华州举行州长选举。民主共和党候选人约瑟夫·哈斯莱特击败联邦党候选人丹尼尔·罗德尼。罗德尼曾任特拉华州普通诉讼法院法官。

en.t: 1827 Delaware's at-large congressional district special election
en.s: A special election was held October 2, 1827 in Delaware's at-large congressional district to fill a vacancy caused by the resignation of Louis McLane (J) before the start of Congress, after being elected to the Senate.

zh.t: 1827年特拉华州全州选区特别选举
zh.s: 1827年10月2日，特拉华州全州选区举行特别选举，以填补路易斯·麦克莱恩辞职后留下的空缺。麦克莱恩当选参议员后，在新一届国会开会前辞去了众议院席位。

en.s: The Battle of Gonzales was the first military engagement of the Texas Revolution. It was fought near Gonzales, Texas, on October 2, 1835, between rebellious Texian settlers and a detachment of Mexican Army soldiers. In 1831, Green DeWitt asked the Mexican authorities to lend the Gonzales colonists a cannon to help protect them from frequent Comanche raids.

zh.s: 冈萨雷斯战役是得克萨斯革命中的首次军事交战，于1835年10月2日在得克萨斯州冈萨雷斯附近爆发。交战双方是反叛的得克萨斯殖民者和一支墨西哥军队分队。1831年，格林·德威特曾请求墨西哥当局借给冈萨雷斯殖民者一门大炮，以保护他们免受科曼奇人频繁袭击。

en.s: The Texas Revolution (October 2, 1835 – April 21, 1836) was a rebellion by Anglo-American immigrants as well as Hispanic Texans (known as Texians and Tejanos respectively) against the centralist government of Mexico in the Mexican state of Coahuila y Tejas. Although the uprising was part of a larger revolt that included other provinces opposed to the regime of President Miguel Barragán and General Antonio López de Santa Anna, the Mexican government believed the United States had instigated the Texas insurrection with the goal of annexation.

zh.s: 德克萨斯革命（1835年10月2日—1836年4月21日）是英裔美国移民和西班牙裔德克萨斯人（分别称为Texians和Tejanos）反抗墨西哥科阿韦拉-德克萨斯州中央集权政府的起义。总统米格尔·巴拉甘和安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德·圣安纳将军统治时期，其他省份也发生了更大规模的反抗。墨西哥政府认为，美国煽动德克萨斯起义，目的是吞并该地。

en.s: The 1837 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 2, 1837, to elect the governor of Georgia. In a major upset, thanks in part to the Panic of 1837, Whig State Rights candidate and Ex-Governor George R. Gilmer beat incumbent Democratic Union Governor Willam Schley.

zh.s: 1837年10月2日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。由于1837年经济恐慌等因素影响，辉格党州权派候选人、前州长乔治·R·吉尔默爆冷击败民主党联盟籍现任州长威廉·施莱。

en.s: The 1843 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 2, 1843, to elect the governor of Georgia. Whig candidate George W. Crawford defeated the Democratic challenger Mark A. Cooper and was elected Governor.

zh.s: 1843年10月2日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。辉格党候选人乔治·W·克劳福德击败民主党候选人马克·A·库珀，当选州长。

en.s: The 1844 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on October 2, 1844, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Whig nominee and former member of the Maryland House of Delegates Thomas Pratt narrowly defeated Democratic nominee and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Maryland's 4th district James Carroll.

zh.s: 1844年10月2日，马里兰州举行州长选举。辉格党候选人、马里兰州众议院前议员托马斯·普拉特以微弱优势击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·卡罗尔。卡罗尔曾任马里兰州第四选区的联邦众议员。

en.s: The Battle of Mulegé was an American attack on Mulegé, Baja California Sur, during the Mexican–American War. On 2 October 1847, United States Marines and sailors fought with Mexican militia.

zh.s: 穆莱赫战役是美墨战争期间美军对下加利福尼亚州南部穆莱赫的一次进攻。1847年10月2日，美国海军陆战队和水兵与墨西哥民兵交战。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Florida, 1848
en.s: The election to the United States House of Representatives in Florida for the 31st Congress was held October 2, 1848. This election was held at the same time as the election for Governor of Florida.

zh.t: 1848年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 佛罗里达州于1848年10月2日举行第31届国会联邦众议院选举，同日还举行了州长选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1848 Florida gubernatorial election was held on October 2, 1848. Whig nominee Thomas Brown defeated the Democratic nominee William Bailey.

zh.s: 1848年10月2日，佛罗里达州举行州长选举。辉格党候选人托马斯·布朗击败民主党候选人威廉·贝利。

en.s: The 1850 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on October 2, 1850, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Democratic nominee and former member of the Maryland House of Delegates Enoch Louis Lowe narrowly defeated Whig nominee William B. Clarke.

zh.s: 1850年10月2日，马里兰州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、马里兰州众议院前议员伊诺克·路易斯·洛以微弱优势击败辉格党候选人威廉·B·克拉克。

en.t: 1854 United States House of Representatives election in Florida
en.s: The 1854 United States House of Representatives election in Florida was held on Monday, October 2, 1854, to elect the single United States Representative from the state of Florida, one from the state's single at-large congressional district, to represent Florida in the 34th Congress. The election coincided with the elections of other offices, including the senatorial election and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1854年佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1854年10月2日星期一，佛罗里达州举行联邦众议院选举，从该州唯一的全州选区选出一名众议员，代表佛罗里达州进入第34届国会。此次选举与其他职位选举同时举行，包括参议员选举以及多项州和地方选举。

en.s: The Battle of Chatra was a conflict that took place during the Indian Rebellion of 1857 between the East India Company and the mutinying sepoys who were allied certain local zamindars. The rebels had amassed a force of 3000 men and had taken the town of Chatra which is located in the Chota Nagpur Division. It was a crucial and bloody military engagement fought on October 2, 1857, during the Indian Rebellion of 1857.

zh.s: 查特拉战役是1857年印度起义期间东印度公司军队与起义土兵之间的冲突，部分地方扎明达尔也与起义者结盟。叛军集结了约3000人，占领了位于乔塔那格浦尔地区的查特拉镇。这场关键且伤亡惨重的战斗于1857年10月2日爆发。

en.s: The 1861 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 2, 1861, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. It was the first gubernatorial election in Georgia under the Confederate States of America and saw Democratic nominee and incumbent Governor Joseph E. Brown win a third term against Anti-Brown Democratic nominee Judge E. A. Nisbet.

zh.s: 1861年10月2日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。这是美国南部邦联成立后该州的首次州长选举。民主党候选人、时任州长约瑟夫·E·布朗击败反布朗派民主党候选人、法官E. A. 尼斯贝特，赢得第三个任期。

en.t: Confederate troops repel the Union attack at Saltville
en.s: On October 2, 1864, Union troops attacked Confederate positions near Saltville, Virginia, but were driven back. This was the First Battle of Saltville.
en.n: The killing of wounded Union prisoners followed the battle; accounts also document hospital killings on October 3.

zh.t: 邦联军击退联邦军对盐维尔的进攻
zh.s: 1864年10月2日，联邦军进攻弗吉尼亚州盐维尔附近的邦联军阵地，但被击退。这是第一次盐维尔战役。
zh.n: 受伤的联邦军战俘在战后遭到杀害，另有医院内的杀人事件记于10月3日。

en.s: The 1865 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on October 2, 1865. Benjamin G. Humphreys defeated Ephraim S. Fisher and William S. Patton. Andrew Johnson appointed William L. Sharkey provisional governor of Mississippi following the conclusion of the American Civil War. A prewar Whig and member of the Antebellum planter class, Sharkey's background reflected the profile of the Southern Unionist planters and entrepreneurs whose support Johnson sought for his planned bid for re-election.

zh.s: 密西西比州于1865年10月2日举行州长选举，本杰明·G·汉弗莱斯击败以法莲·S·费舍尔和威廉·S·巴顿。美国内战结束后，安德鲁·约翰逊任命威廉·L·沙基为密西西比州临时州长。沙基战前曾是辉格党人，也是战前种植园主阶层的一员；他的背景符合约翰逊希望争取的南方联邦主义种植园主和企业家形象，以支持其谋求连任的计划。

en.s: The Siege of Ura-Tyube (27 September–2 October 1866) was part of an unapproved Russian military operation during the Russian conquest of Bukhara and Russo-Kokand War. The operation was led by Military Governor Dmitry Romanovsky and aimed to capture several settlements on the Russo-Bukharan border including Ura-Tyube. Ura-Tyube had declared independence from the Emirate of Bukhara several months before the siege, and sent horsemen to harass Romanovsky's forces, stationed in Khujand after its capture.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 乌拉秋别围城战于1866年9月27日至10月2日进行，是俄罗斯征服布哈拉和俄科战争期间未经批准的一次军事行动。行动由军事总督德米特里·罗曼诺夫斯基领导，目标是攻占俄布边境上的多个定居点，包括乌拉秋别。围城发生前数月，乌拉秋别已宣布脱离布哈拉埃米尔国独立，并派骑兵骚扰驻扎在被俄军攻占后的苦盏城中的罗曼诺夫斯基部队。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: By plebiscite, the citizens of the Papal States accept annexation by the Kingdom of Italy
en.s: The capture of Rome (Italian: Presa di Roma) occurred on 20 September 1870, as forces of the Kingdom of Italy took control of the city and of the Papal States. After a plebiscite held on 2 October 1870, Rome was officially made capital of Italy on 3 February 1871, completing the unification of Italy (Risorgimento).

zh.t: 教皇国公民公投接受并入意大利王国
zh.s: 罗马攻占战（意大利语：Presa di Roma）发生于1870年9月20日，意大利王国军队控制了罗马和教皇国。1870年10月2日举行公民投票后，罗马于1871年2月3日正式成为意大利首都，意大利统一运动至此完成。

en.s: The 1872 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 2, 1872, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee and incumbent Governor James Milton Smith defeated Republican nominee and former Justice of the Supreme Court of Georgia Dawson A. Walker.

zh.s: 1872年10月2日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、时任州长詹姆斯·米尔顿·史密斯击败共和党候选人、佐治亚州最高法院前法官道森·A·沃克。

en.t: The Treaty of Livadia was an unequal treaty between the Russian Empire and the Chinese Qing dynasty signed in Livadiya, Crimea, on 2 October 1879, wherein Russia agreed to return a portion of the lands it had occupied in Xinjiang during the Dungan Revolt of 1862–1877, even though Qing forces obtained the area
en.s: The Treaty of Livadia was an unequal treaty between the Russian Empire and the Chinese Qing dynasty signed in Livadiya, Crimea, on 2 October 1879, wherein Russia agreed to return a portion of the lands it had occupied in Xinjiang during the Dungan Revolt of 1862–1877, even though Qing forces obtained the area.

zh.s: 《利瓦迪亚条约》是俄罗斯帝国与中国清朝于1879年10月2日在克里米亚利瓦迪亚签署的一项不平等条约。条约规定，俄罗斯同意归还其在1862至1877年同治陕甘回变期间占领的新疆部分地区，尽管清军已夺回该地区。

en.t: The Guangxu Emperor approves the founding of Peiyang University’s predecessor
en.s: On October 2, 1895, the Guangxu Emperor approved Sheng Xuanhuai’s proposal to establish a university in Tianjin. The institution developed into Peiyang University and later Tianjin University.
en.n: The date records approval for the founding, rather than the first day of classes.

zh.t: 光绪帝批准创办北洋大学前身
zh.s: 1895年10月2日，光绪帝批准盛宣怀在天津创办新式大学的奏请。这所学校后来发展为北洋大学，即今天的天津大学。
zh.n: 这里记录获准创办的日期，并非第一天上课。

en.s: The 1901 Nova Scotia general election was held on 2 October 1901 to elect members of the 33rd House of Assembly of the province of Nova Scotia, Canada. It was won by the Liberal party.

zh.s: 加拿大新斯科舍省于1901年10月2日举行大选，选出该省第33届议会的议员。自由党获胜。

en.s: The 1908 Richmond state by-election was held on 2 October 1908 to elect the member for Richmond in the Victorian Legislative Assembly, following the death of United Liberal Party (ULP) MP George Henry Bennett. Labor candidate Ted Cotter won the seat with a swing of more than 36%, defeating ULP candidate William Wishart.

zh.s: 1908年10月2日，维多利亚州立法议会里士满选区举行补选，起因是联合自由党议员乔治·亨利·贝内特去世。工党候选人泰德·科特以超过36个百分点的优势摆幅击败联合自由党候选人威廉·威沙特，赢得席位。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 2 October 1909 to elect the members of the state's Legislative Assembly. This election used contingent voting, at least in the single-member districts. Five districts were two-seat districts - Mackay, Marlborough, North Brisbane, Rockhampton and South Brisbane. In the two-member constituencies, plurality block voting was used -- electors could cast two valid votes but were allowed to "plump".

zh.s: 澳大利亚昆士兰州于1909年10月2日举行选举，选出州立法议会议员。此次选举采用排序投票制，至少在单议席选区如此。麦凯、马尔伯勒、北布里斯班、罗克汉普顿和南布里斯班五个选区各有两个席位，采用多席位简单多数制，选民可以投两票，也可以集中只投给一名候选人。

en.s: The 1912 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 2, 1912, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee and former Acting Governor of Georgia John M. Slaton ran unopposed and subsequently won the election.

zh.s: 1912年10月2日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、佐治亚州前代理州长约翰·M·斯莱顿未经竞争便当选。

en.s: The Battle of Báránykút was a military engagement during the Battle of Transylvania, at the beginning of the Romanian Campaign of World War I. It consisted of a German offensive that was successfully repulsed by the Romanians, who then carried out a largely unhindered tactical retreat.

zh.s: 巴兰尼库特战役是特兰西瓦尼亚战役期间的一次军事交战，发生于一战罗马尼亚战役初期。德军发动攻势，罗马尼亚军队成功将其击退，随后基本不受阻碍地进行战术撤退。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in the Grand Duchy of Finland on 1 and 2 October 1917. The general voter turnout was higher than in previous elections. The Social Democrats lost the absolute majority that they had had in the previous two elections (although they, like the other parties, had increased their number of votes in absolute terms).

zh.s: 芬兰大公国于1917年10月1日和2日举行议会选举。总体投票率高于此前的选举。社会民主党失去了此前连续两次选举中取得的绝对多数，尽管和其他政党一样，该党得票总数有所增加。

en.s: The Second Battle of Durazzo, or the Bombardment of Durazzo was a naval battle fought in the Adriatic Sea during the First World War. A large allied fleet led by the Regia Marina attacked the enemy-held port at Durazzo, Albania. The fleet destroyed the Austro-Hungarian shore defenses and skirmished with a small naval force. Allied forces involved primarily were Italian though British, American and Australian warships also participated.

zh.s: 第二次杜拉佐海战又称杜拉佐炮击战，是一战期间在亚得里亚海进行的海战。意大利皇家海军率领的大型协约国舰队攻击了敌军控制的阿尔巴尼亚港口杜拉佐，摧毁奥匈帝国岸防并与一支小型海军力量交战。参战的协约国部队以意大利为主，也包括英国、美国和澳大利亚军舰。

en.s: On October 2, 1918, Bulgarian government forces captured Radomir from the soldiers who had risen against the government. The recapture suppressed the Radomir Rebellion.
en.n: Bulgaria’s armistice had been signed on September 29; Ferdinand I abdicated on October 3.

zh.t: 保加利亚政府军收复拉多米尔
zh.s: 1918年10月2日，保加利亚政府军从起义士兵手中夺回拉多米尔，镇压了拉多米尔起义。
zh.n: 保加利亚已在9月29日签署停战协定，斐迪南一世于10月3日退位。

en.t: Finnish volunteers from the Viena expedition return to Finland
en.s: On October 2, 1918, about 195 Finnish volunteers from Toivo Kuisma’s detachment reached Finland after withdrawing from White Karelia.
en.n: This records the return of Kuisma’s group, rather than the end of every Finnish operation in the region.

zh.t: 维纳远征中的芬兰志愿兵返回芬兰
zh.s: 1918年10月2日，托伊沃·奎斯马部队中约195名芬兰志愿兵撤出白海卡累利阿后，返回芬兰。
zh.n: 这里记录奎斯马部队返回芬兰，并非该地区所有芬兰军事行动都在当天结束。

en.s: The Fifth Battle of Ypres, also called the Advance in Flanders and the Battle of the Peaks of Flanders (French: Bataille des Crêtes de Flandres) is an informal name of First World War battles in northern France and southern Belgium (Flanders) from late September to October 1918.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “第五次伊普尔战役”也称“佛兰德斯推进战役”或“佛兰德斯高地战役”（法语：Bataille des Crêtes de Flandres），是对第一次世界大战期间一系列战斗的非正式称呼。这些战斗于1918年9月下旬至10月在法国北部和比利时南部的佛兰德斯地区进行。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Charge at Khan Ayash occurred on 2 October 1918 about 17 miles (27 km) north of Damascus after the pursuit to, and capture of Damascus, which followed the decisive Egyptian Expeditionary Force victory at the Battle of Megiddo on 25 September during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of World War I.

zh.s: 1918年10月2日，汗阿亚什冲锋发生在大马士革以北约17英里（27公里）处。此前，埃及远征军于9月25日在西奈和巴勒斯坦战役的米吉多战役中取得决定性胜利，随后部队一路追击并攻占大马士革。

en.t: The "Prelature of the Holy Cross and the Work of God", commonly known as Opus Dei, is founded
en.s: Opus Dei (Latin for 'Work of God') is a personal prelature of the Catholic Church founded in Spain on 2 October 1928 by Josemaría Escrivá. The prelature states that it helps lay and clerical members pursue holiness through everyday occupations and social responsibilities. The Holy See granted final approval in 1950 under Pope Pius XII. In 1982 Pope John Paul II affirmed its status as a personal prelature through the apostolic constitution Ut sit.

zh.s: 主业会（拉丁语意为“上帝的事业”）是天主教会的个人监督区，由何塞玛丽亚·埃斯克里瓦于1928年10月2日在西班牙创立。主业会称，其宗旨是帮助平信徒和神职人员在日常工作和社会责任中追求圣德。教廷于1950年在教宗庇护十二世任内给予最终批准。1982年，教宗若望·保禄二世通过《Ut sit》宗座宪章确认了其个人监督区地位。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Finland on 1 and 2 October 1930. The Social Democratic Party emerged as the largest in Parliament with 66 of the 200 seats. Voter turnout was 65.9%.

zh.s: 芬兰于1930年10月1日和2日举行议会选举。社会民主党成为议会第一大党，在200个席位中赢得66席。投票率为65.9%。

en.t: São Paulo’s state government is deposed as the Constitutionalist Revolution ends
en.s: On October 2, 1932, Colonel Herculano de Carvalho deposed São Paulo’s state government and assumed interim power. The change marked the end of the Constitutionalist Revolution against Brazil’s federal government.
en.n: This records the transfer of political authority; fighting and disarmament were not a single action completed everywhere at once.

zh.t: 圣保罗州政府被解除职权，护宪革命结束
zh.s: 1932年10月2日，赫尔库拉诺·德·卡瓦略上校解除圣保罗州政府职权，并暂时代行权力。这次权力更替标志着反对巴西联邦政府的护宪革命结束。
zh.n: 这里记录政治权力交接，各地停战和缴械并非在同一时刻完成。

en.s: The 1937 Victorian state election was held in the Australian state of Victoria on Saturday 2 October 1937 to elect 45 of the 65 members of the state's Legislative Assembly.

zh.s: 澳大利亚维多利亚州于1937年10月2日星期六举行州选举，选出该州立法议会65名议员中的45名。

en.t: Trujillo publicly acknowledges killings of Haitians at Dajabón
en.s: On October 2, 1937, Rafael Trujillo spoke at a celebration in Dajabón in the Dominican Republic. He acknowledged killings of Haitians that had already taken place and said they would continue.
en.n: The killings had already begun; this date records Trujillo’s public statement.

zh.t: 特鲁希略在达哈邦公开谈及对海地人的杀戮
zh.s: 1937年10月2日，拉斐尔·特鲁希略在多米尼加共和国达哈邦的一场庆祝活动上讲话，承认已有海地人遭到杀害，并表示杀戮还会继续。
zh.n: 杀戮此前已开始，这里记录的是特鲁希略公开讲话的日期。

en.s: The Battle of Kock was the final battle in the Invasion of Poland at the beginning of World War II in Europe. It took place between 2–5 October 1939, near the town of Kock, in Poland. The Polish Polesie Independent Operational Group, led by General Franciszek Kleeberg, fought the German 14th Motorised Corps, led by General Gustav Anton von Wietersheim.

zh.s: 科克战役是二战初期波兰战役的最后一场战斗，于1939年10月2日至5日在波兰科克镇附近发生。弗朗齐谢克·克莱贝格将军率领波兰波列谢独立作战群，对阵古斯塔夫·安东·冯·维特斯海姆将军指挥的德军第14摩托化军。

en.s: The Battle of Hel (Polish: Obrona Helu, literally "the Defense of Hel") was a World War II engagement fought from 1 September to 2 October 1939 on the Hel Peninsula, of the Baltic Sea coast, between invading German forces and defending Polish units during the German invasion of Poland (also known in Polish historiography as the September Campaign).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 海尔战役发生于1939年9月1日至10月2日，是二战期间德国入侵波兰行动中的一场战斗，地点在波罗的海海岸的海尔半岛，交战双方是德军和波兰守军。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Moscow was a military campaign that consisted of two periods of strategically significant fighting on a 600 km (370 mi) sector of the Eastern Front during World War II, between October 1941 and January 1942. The Soviet defensive effort thwarted Germany's attack on Moscow, the capital and largest city of the Soviet Union.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 莫斯科会战发生于第二次世界大战期间的1941年10月至1942年1月，由两个具有重大战略意义的战斗阶段组成，战场位于东线一段600公里（370英里）长的战线上。苏军的防御挫败了德军对苏联首都兼最大城市莫斯科的进攻。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 1943 Auburn state by-election was held on 2 October 1943 to elect the member for Auburn in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly, following the resignation of Jack Lang, who contested the seat of Reid at the 1946 federal election. Having been unsuccessful in his federal election campaign, Lang recontested Auburn at the by-election and was re-elected with 57.89% of the primary vote.

zh.s: 1943年10月2日，新南威尔士州立法议会奥本选区举行补选。此前，杰克·朗辞去该席位，转而参加1946年联邦大选，角逐里德选区。联邦大选失利后，朗再次竞选奥本选区席位，并以57.89%的首轮得票率当选。

en.s: On October 2, 1943, Australia’s 20th Infantry Brigade entered Finschhafen in New Guinea after advancing from Scarlet Beach. Japanese forces had begun withdrawing from the town.
en.n: The landing at Scarlet Beach had taken place in September; this entry records the advance into Finschhafen.

zh.s: 1943年10月2日，澳大利亚第20步兵旅从斯卡利特海滩向前推进，进入新几内亚的芬施哈芬。日军此前已开始撤出城镇。
zh.n: 斯卡利特海滩登陆发生在9月，这里记录的是进入芬施哈芬。

en.s: The second Smolensk operation (code naming "Suvorov"; 7 August – 2 October 1943) was a Soviet strategic offensive operation conducted by the Red Army as part of the Summer-Autumn Campaign of 1943. Staged almost simultaneously with the Lower Dnieper Offensive (13 August – 22 September), the offensive lasted two months and was led by General Andrei Yeremenko, commanding the Kalinin Front, and Vasily Sokolovsky, commanding the Western Front.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第二次斯摩棱斯克战役的代号为“苏沃洛夫行动”，于1943年8月7日至10月2日进行，是红军1943年夏秋攻势中的一项苏联战略进攻行动。它几乎与下第聂伯河攻势（8月13日至9月22日）同时展开，历时两个月，由加里宁方面军司令安德烈·叶廖缅科和西方面军司令瓦西里·索科洛夫斯基率领。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: An agreement ending the Warsaw Uprising is signed
en.s: On October 2, 1944, representatives of the Polish Home Army and the German command concluded an agreement at Ożarów near Warsaw to end hostilities in the city. The agreement provided for a ceasefire that evening.
en.n: The agreement and ceasefire preceded the insurgents’ later disarmament and departure.

zh.t: 结束华沙起义战斗的协议签署
zh.s: 1944年10月2日，波兰家乡军与德军代表在华沙附近的奥扎鲁夫签署协议，结束华沙的战斗。协议规定当晚停火。
zh.n: 签署协议和停火在前，起义军随后才缴械离城。

en.s: The Battle of Maguwo (Indonesian: Pertempuran Maguwo) was a battle between the newly founded Indonesian People's Security Agency against the Imperial Japanese military, which occurred on 2 October 1945 in Yogyakarta.

zh.s: 马古沃战役是新成立的印度尼西亚人民安全局与日本帝国军队之间的一场战斗，于1945年10月2日在日惹发生。

en.s: The 1948 Progressive Conservative leadership election was held to choose a leader for the Progressive Conservative Party of Canada. The convention was held at the Ottawa Coliseum in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. Voting occurred on October 2, 1948. Premier of Ontario George A. Drew was elected as the party's new leader.

zh.t: 1948年加拿大进步保守党党魁大会
zh.s: 1948年举行进步保守党党魁选举，选出加拿大进步保守党的新党魁。大会在加拿大安大略省渥太华的渥太华体育馆举行，投票于1948年10月2日进行。安大略省省长乔治·A·德鲁当选新党魁。

en.s: The 1956 Newfoundland general election was held on 2 October 1956 to elect members of the 31st General Assembly of Newfoundland. It was won by the Liberal party.

zh.s: 纽芬兰于1956年10月2日举行大选，选出第31届议会的议员。自由党获胜。

en.s: On October 2, 1958, Guinea proclaimed independence from France. Its Territorial Assembly declared independence and became a sovereign National Assembly, following the September 28 referendum.
en.n: The independence proclamation followed the referendum held four days earlier.

zh.t: 几内亚宣布脱离法国独立
zh.s: 1958年10月2日，几内亚宣布脱离法国独立。领土议会在9月28日公投后正式宣布独立，并改组为主权国家的国民议会。
zh.n: 独立宣告在公投四天后作出。

en.s: The 1966 All-Ireland Under-21 Hurling Championship final was a hurling match played at Nowlan Park, Kilkenny on 2 October 1966 to determine the winners of the 1966 All-Ireland Under-21 Hurling Championship, the 3rd season of the All-Ireland Under-21 Hurling Championship, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the champion teams of the four provinces of Ireland.

zh.t: 1966年全爱尔兰21岁以下高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1966年全爱尔兰21岁以下高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛于1966年10月2日在基尔肯尼的诺兰公园举行，决出该届赛事冠军。这是赛事创办后的第三个赛季，由盖尔运动协会组织，参赛队为爱尔兰四个省的冠军球队。

en.t: Mexican forces open fire on a student rally at Tlatelolco
en.s: On October 2, 1968, Mexican forces opened fire during a student rally at the Plaza de las Tres Culturas in Tlatelolco, Mexico City. The massacre killed an uncertain number of people.
en.n: The massacre occurred ten days before the opening of the Mexico City Olympics.

zh.t: 墨西哥军队在特拉特洛尔科向学生集会开枪
zh.s: 1968年10月2日，墨西哥军队在墨西哥城特拉特洛尔科的三文化广场向学生集会开枪，酿成屠杀。死亡人数至今说法不一。
zh.n: 事件发生在墨西哥城奥运会开幕前十天。

en.s: The 22nd Locarno Film Festival was held from 2 to 12 October 1969 in Locarno, Switzerland. The festival was highlighted for its continued focus on first and second films from directors and for bringing a bigger audience to the Czech New Wave.
en.n: This entry records the opening, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第22届洛迦诺电影节于1969年10月2日至12日在瑞士洛迦诺举行。电影节继续关注导演的第一部和第二部作品，并吸引了更多观众关注捷克新浪潮电影。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的开幕日期。

en.t: Wichita State University football team plane crash
en.s: In clear and calm weather at 1:14 p.m. on Friday, October 2, 1970, a chartered Martin 4-0-4 airliner crashed into a mountain eight miles (13 km) west of Silver Plume, Colorado. Operated by Golden Eagle Aviation, the twin-engined propliner carried 37 passengers and a crew of three; 29 were killed at the scene and two later died of their injuries while under medical care. It was one of a two-aircraft flight carrying the Wichita State University football team to Logan, Utah, for a game against Utah State University; the second aircraft flew a different route and arrived safely in Utah.

zh.t: 威奇托州立大学橄榄球队飞机空难
zh.s: 1970年10月2日星期五下午1时14分，天气晴朗平静，一架包机马丁4-0-4客机在科罗拉多州西尔弗普卢姆以西8英里（13公里）处撞山。该机由金鹰航空运营，搭载37名乘客和3名机组人员；29人当场死亡，另有两人后来在接受治疗时伤重不治。这是两架搭载威奇托州立大学橄榄球队、飞往犹他州洛根参加比赛的飞机之一；另一架飞机走了不同航线，安全抵达犹他州。

en.s: British European Airways Flight 706 (BE706/BEA706) was a scheduled international passenger flight from London, England to Salzburg, Austria. On 2 October 1971, whilst en route at 19,000 feet (5,791 m), the pressure bulkhead of the Vickers Vanguard at the rear of the cabin failed. The resulting depressurisation of the tail section caused the surfaces of the tailplanes to separate.

zh.t: 英国欧洲航空706号班机空难
zh.s: 英国欧洲航空706号班机（BE706/BEA706）是从英国伦敦飞往奥地利萨尔茨堡的定期国际客运航班。1971年10月2日，飞机在高度19,000英尺（5,791米）巡航时，维克斯子爵式客机后舱的压力隔板破裂，导致尾部失压，水平尾翼随即脱落。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in South Vietnam on 2 October 1971. After the opposition candidates Dương Văn Minh and Nguyễn Cao Kỳ withdrew their candidacies (most opposition figures had already been banned from the ballot), incumbent President Nguyễn Văn Thiệu was the only candidate, receiving 100% of the vote. Thiệu's victory in this election officially marked his second term in office.

zh.s: 南越于1971年10月2日举行总统选举。反对派候选人杨文明和阮高祺退选（多数反对派人士此前已被禁止参选）后，时任总统阮文绍成为唯一候选人，获得100%的选票。阮文绍获胜，正式开始第二个任期。

en.s: The 1977 Bangladesh Air Force mutiny was an attempted coup staged on 2 October 1977 by members of Bangladesh Air Force and the Signal Corps of Bangladesh Army, which took place while negotiations were ongoing between the Bangladesh government and the Japanese Red Army, who had hijacked a plane and diverted it to Dhaka airport.

zh.s: 1977年10月2日，孟加拉国空军和孟加拉国陆军通信兵部队成员发动政变未遂。当时，孟加拉国政府正与劫持飞机并将其转降达卡机场的日本赤军进行谈判。

en.t: The U.S. House expels Representative Michael Myers
en.s: On October 2, 1980, the U.S. House of Representatives voted 376–30 to expel Michael J. Myers following his bribery conviction. He was the first House member expelled since the Civil War.
en.n: His criminal conviction preceded the expulsion vote.

zh.t: 美国众议院开除议员迈克尔·迈尔斯
zh.s: 1980年10月2日，美国众议院以376票赞成、30票反对，将已被判贿赂罪的迈克尔·J·迈尔斯开除。他成为南北战争以来首位被开除的众议员。
zh.n: 刑事定罪在前，众议院于这一天表决将他开除。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Iran on 2 October 1981 following the assassination of president Mohammad-Ali Rajai. Ali Khamenei was elected with 95% of the vote.

zh.s: 1981年10月2日，伊朗在总统穆罕默德-阿里·拉贾伊遇刺后举行总统选举。阿里·哈梅内伊以95%的得票率当选。

en.s: A deputy leadership election for the Labour Party in the United Kingdom took place on 2 October 1983 to replace incumbent Deputy Leader Denis Healey. Healey had served in the position since 1980, becoming deputy leader at the same time that Michael Foot became party leader. Foot and Healey had both announced their resignations following the general election on 9 June 1983, in which a disastrous performance left the Labour Party with just 209 seats in parliament.

zh.s: 英国工党于1983年10月2日举行副党魁选举，以接替时任副党魁丹尼斯·希利。希利自1980年起担任副党魁，当时迈克尔·富特也同时出任工党党魁。1983年6月9日大选后，富特和希利均宣布辞职；工党表现惨败，在议会中仅获209席。

en.s: The 1983 Labour Party leadership election was an election in the United Kingdom for the leadership of the Labour Party. It occurred when Michael Foot resigned as Leader after the party won only 209 seats at the 1983 general election, a loss of 60 seats from its performance at the previous election four years earlier. This was the worst showing for Labour since 1935.

zh.s: 英国于1983年举行工党党魁选举。迈克尔·富特因工党在1983年大选中仅获209席而辞去党魁职务，比四年前少了60席。这是工党自1935年以来表现最差的一次。

en.s: The 1984 Anchorage mayoral election was held on October 2, 1984, to elect the mayor of Anchorage, Alaska. It saw reelection of Tony Knowles. Since at least one candidate (in this instance, two candidates) had received 40% of the vote (which at least one candidate was required to obtain to avoid a runoff), no runoff was needed.

zh.s: 1984年10月2日，安克雷奇举行市长选举，托尼·诺尔斯再次当选。至少有一名候选人（本次有两人）得票率达到40%，达到避免举行第二轮投票的门槛，因此无需举行第二轮。

en.s: A deputy leadership election for the Labour Party in the United Kingdom took place on 2 October 1988 when John Prescott and Eric Heffer challenged Labour's incumbent Deputy Leader Roy Hattersley. Hattersley had served in the position since 1983. The election was conducted using the Labour Party's Electoral College. Delegates at Labour Party conference voted in the election, with 40% of votes going to affiliated unions, 30% to constituency parties and 30% to the Parliamentary Labour Party.

zh.s: 1988年10月2日，工党副党魁选举举行，约翰·普雷斯科特和埃里克·赫弗挑战时任副党魁罗伊·哈特斯利。哈特斯利自1983年起担任副党魁。选举采用工党的选举人团制度，由工党大会代表投票；其中40%的选票来自附属工会，30%来自选区党组织，另外30%来自工党议员团。

en.s: The 1988 Labour Party leadership election saw Tony Benn, identified with the left wing of the British Labour Party, challenge the incumbent leader Neil Kinnock identified with the more moderate social democratic wing. Kinnock won the election with 89% of the vote and remained Leader until 1992, when he resigned the leadership following Labour's defeat in the 1992 United Kingdom general election.

zh.s: 1988年英国工党党魁选举中，代表工党左翼的托尼·本恩挑战时任党魁、代表较温和社会民主派的尼尔·金诺克。金诺克以89%的得票率获胜，留任至1992年。工党在1992年英国大选中落败后，他辞去党魁职务。

en.s: On 2 October 1990, a hijacked Boeing 737-200, operating Xiamen Airlines Flight 8301, collided with two other aircraft at the old Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport while attempting to land. The hijacked aircraft struck parked China Southwest Airlines Flight 4305 first, a Boeing 707, inflicting only minor damage, but then collided with CAAC Flight 3523, a Boeing 757 waiting to take off, flipping onto its back.

zh.t: 1990年广州白云机场连环撞机事故
zh.s: 1990年10月2日，一架遭劫持的波音737-200客机执行厦门航空8301号班机，在试图降落旧广州白云国际机场时与另外两架飞机相撞。劫机客机先撞上停放着的中国西南航空4305号波音707，仅造成轻微损坏；随后又撞上正等待起飞的中国民航3523号波音757，将其撞翻在地。

en.s: The 1990 Anchorage mayoral election was held on October 2 and October 30, 1990, to elect the mayor of Anchorage, Alaska. It saw reelection of Tom Fink. Since at no candidate received 40% of the vote in the first round (which at least one candidate was required to obtain to avoid a runoff), a runoff was held between the top-two finishers of the first round.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 安克雷奇于1990年10月2日和30日举行市长选举，汤姆·芬克成功连任。第一轮投票中无人达到避免第二轮所需的40%得票率，因此得票最高的两名候选人进入第二轮。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第一轮投票日期。

en.s: NWA Bloodfest was a professional wrestling live event produced by the National Wrestling Alliance (NWA) affiliate Eastern Championship Wrestling (ECW) on October 1 and October 2, 1993. The event was held in the ECW Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania in the United States. NWA Bloodfest was the second ECW event to be produced by Paul Heyman, who had taken over booking of the promotion from Tod Gordon earlier that year.

zh.s: NWA血腥节是美国国家摔角联盟（NWA）旗下东部冠军摔角（ECW）于1993年10月1日和2日举办的现场职业摔角赛事。比赛在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城的ECW竞技场举行。这是保罗·海曼于当年接替托德·戈登、负责赛事编排后制作的第二场ECW赛事。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的赛事日期。

en.s: On October 2, 1993, forces loyal to Georgia’s ousted president Zviad Gamsakhurdia attacked and captured the Black Sea port of Poti.
en.n: This was the rebel capture of the port, before later attempts to retake it.

zh.t: 加姆萨胡尔季阿的部队攻占波季
zh.s: 1993年10月2日，忠于格鲁吉亚被推翻的总统兹维阿德·加姆萨胡尔季阿的部队发动进攻，夺取黑海港口波季。
zh.n: 这里记录反政府部队攻占港口，政府军后来才试图将其夺回。

en.s: The Democratic Party leadership election was held on 2 October 1994 for the leadership including chairman, two vice-chairman posts and 27 members of the 3rd Central Committee of the new Democratic Party in Hong Kong. It was held at the first party congress on the establishment day of the Democratic Party. Well-known popular democrat activist, Chairman of the United Democrats of Hong Kong Martin Lee became the first Chairman, while Anthony Cheung, the Chairman of the Meeting Point, and Yeung Sum became the two Vice-Chairmen.

zh.s: 1994年10月2日，香港民主党举行党魁选举，选出主席、两名副主席和新民主党第三届中央委员会27名成员。选举在民主党成立当天的首次党代表大会上进行。知名民主派人士、香港民主同盟主席李柱铭当选首任主席；汇点主席张炳良和杨森当选两名副主席。

en.s: The 1994 Asian Games (1994年アジア競技大会), also known as the XII Asiad and the 12th Asian Games (第12回アジア競技大会) or simply Hiroshima 1994 (広島1994), were held from October 2 to 16, 1994, in Hiroshima, Japan. It was the first Asian Games in history to be hosted in a non-capital city. The main theme of this edition was to promote peace and harmony among Asian nations.

zh.s: 第12届亚洲运动会又称“广岛1994”，于1994年10月2日至16日在日本广岛举行。这是亚洲运动会首次在非首都城市举办。本届赛事的主题是促进亚洲各国间的和平与和谐。

en.s: Aeroperú Flight 603 was a scheduled passenger flight from Miami International Airport in Miami, Florida, United States, to Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport in Santiago, Chile, with stopovers in Quito, Ecuador, and Lima, Peru. On October 2, 1996, the Boeing 757 aircraft flying the final leg of the flight crashed into the Pacific Ocean. There were no survivors among 70 people on board.

zh.s: 秘鲁航空603号班机是从美国佛罗里达州迈阿密国际机场飞往智利圣地亚哥阿图罗·梅里诺·贝尼特斯国际机场的定期客运航班，中途经停厄瓜多尔基多和秘鲁利马。1996年10月2日，执行最后一段航程的波音757客机坠入太平洋。机上70人无人生还。

en.t: Bill Clinton signs the Electronic Freedom of Information Act Amendments
en.s: On October 2, 1996, U.S. President Bill Clinton signed the Electronic Freedom of Information Act Amendments of 1996 into law. The amendments clarified that the Freedom of Information Act applied to electronic records and expanded public access to government information.
en.n: This is the signing date; Congress had passed the bill in September.

zh.t: 克林顿签署《电子信息自由法修正案》
zh.s: 1996年10月2日，美国总统比尔·克林顿签署《1996年电子信息自由法修正案》，使其成为法律。修正案明确《信息自由法》也适用于电子记录，并扩大了公众获取政府信息的渠道。
zh.n: 这是总统签署的日期，国会已在9月通过法案。

en.s: The 1999 Rebellion was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the American promotion World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE) and broadcast exclusively in the United Kingdom. It was the inaugural Rebellion and took place on October 2, 1999, at the National Indoor Arena in Birmingham, England.

zh.s: 1999年《叛乱》是美国世界摔角联盟（WWF，现WWE）制作并仅在英国播出的职业摔角付费观看赛事。这是首届《叛乱》赛事，于1999年10月2日在英格兰伯明翰的国家室内体育馆举行。

en.s: The 1999 Ms. Olympia contest was an IFBB professional bodybuilding competition held October 2, 1999, in Secaucus, New Jersey, alongside the 1999 Women's Pro Extravaganza. It was the 20th Ms. Olympia competition held.

zh.s: 1999年奥林匹亚女士大赛是国际健美联合会（IFBB）举办的职业健美比赛，于1999年10月2日在新泽西州锡考克斯与1999年女子职业健美盛会同期举行。这是第20届奥林匹亚女士大赛。

en.s: The 2001 Albuquerque mayoral election took place on October 2, 2001. Incumbent Mayor Jim Baca ran for re-election to a second term. He faced a crowded field of competitors, including former Mayor Martin Chávez, the Democratic nominee for Governor in 1998; former District Attorney Bob Schwartz; City Councilors Mike McEntee and Alan Armijo; and former State Treasurer James B. Lewis.

zh.s: 2001年10月2日，阿尔伯克基举行市长选举。时任市长吉姆·巴卡竞选连任第二个任期。他的竞争对手众多，包括前市长马丁·查韦斯（1998年民主党州长候选人）、前地方检察官鲍勃·施瓦茨、市议员迈克·麦肯蒂和艾伦·阿米霍，以及前州财政官詹姆斯·B·刘易斯。

en.t: The October Beltway sniper killings begin in Maryland
en.s: On October 2, 2002, a 55-year-old man was shot dead in a parking lot in Wheaton, Maryland. It was the first fatal shooting in the October series of Beltway sniper attacks.
en.n: The perpetrators had carried out other shootings earlier in 2002. This entry concerns the October series around Washington.

zh.t: 华盛顿地区十月连环狙击杀人案在马里兰州开始
zh.s: 2002年10月2日，一名55岁男子在马里兰州惠顿的一处停车场遭枪击身亡。这是十月环城公路连环狙击案的首起致命枪击。
zh.n: 作案者在2002年早些时候已实施过其他枪击，这里记录的是十月在华盛顿周边发生的系列案件。

en.s: The following riding results occurred during the 2003 Ontario general election held on October 2, 2003.

zh.s: 以下为安大略省于2003年10月2日举行的大选各选区结果。

en.s: General elections were held on October 2, 2003, to elect the 103 members of the 38th Legislative Assembly (Members of Provincial Parliament, or "MPPs") of the province of Ontario, Canada. The election was called on September 2 by Premier Ernie Eves in the wake of supporting polls for the governing Ontario Progressive Conservative Party in the days following the 2003 North American blackout.

zh.s: 安大略省于2003年10月2日举行大选，选出省立法议会第38届议会的103名议员。省长厄尼·伊夫斯于9月2日宣布举行选举；此前2003年北美大停电后，民调一度显示执政的安大略进步保守党支持度上升。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 2 October 2004 to elect mayors and assemblies in 144 municipalities and cities.

zh.t: 2004年波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那地方选举
zh.s: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那于2004年10月2日举行地方选举，改选144个市镇和城市的市长及议会成员。

en.s: The 2005 Styrian state election was held on 2 October 2005 to elect the members of the Landtag of Styria. The result was a historic defeat for the Austrian People's Party (ÖVP), who had governed the state uninterrupted since 1945. The Social Democratic Party of Austria (SPÖ) became the largest party on a swing of over nine percentage points.

zh.s: 2005年10月2日，施蒂里亚州举行州议会选举。奥地利人民党（ÖVP）遭遇历史性惨败，该党自1945年以来一直统治该州。奥地利社会民主党（SPÖ）支持率上升超过9个百分点，成为第一大党。

en.t: 2005 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship final
en.s: The 2005 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship Final featured Cork and Galway. It was Cork's first final and Galway's second. Galway were also the reigning champions, having won the 2004 final. Galway led 0–4 to 0–3 at half-time, but Player of the Match, Valerie Mulcahy, subsequently scored 1–5 to help Cork win their first All-Ireland title. Cork eventually won 1–11 to 0–8.

zh.t: 2005年全爱尔兰女子高级足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2005年全爱尔兰女子高级足球锦标赛决赛由科克队对阵戈尔韦队。这是科克首次打进决赛，戈尔韦则第二次晋级。戈尔韦还是卫冕冠军，曾赢得2004年决赛。戈尔韦半场以0比4领先0比3，但本场最佳球员瓦莱丽·穆尔卡希随后攻入1球、贡献5分，帮助科克首次赢得全爱尔兰冠军。科克最终以1比11比0比8获胜。

en.s: On October 2, 2006, a mass shooting occurred at the West Nickel Mines School, an Amish one-room schoolhouse in the Old Order Amish community of Nickel Mines, a village in Bart Township, Pennsylvania. 32-year-old Charles Carl Roberts IV took hostages and shot ten girls (aged 6–13), killing six (five in the initial incident, and a sixth who succumbed to her injuries in 2024), before dying by suicide in the schoolhouse.

zh.t: 西尼克尔矿区学校枪击案
zh.s: 2006年10月2日，美国宾夕法尼亚州巴特县尼克尔矿区的旧秩序阿米什人社区内，西尼克尔矿区学校发生大规模枪击案。32岁的查尔斯·卡尔·罗伯茨四世劫持人质，向10名6至13岁的女孩开枪，造成6人死亡（5人当场死亡，另有1人于2024年因伤去世），随后他在校舍内自杀。

en.t: 2006 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship final
en.s: The 2006 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship Final featured Cork and Armagh. Armagh led 1–4 to 0–3 at half-time but a goal from player of the match, Nollaig Cleary, helped Cork to a one-point win. It was also the second of five consecutive All-Ireland finals that Cork would win between 2005 and 2009. The Armagh team featured Caroline O'Hanlon, a Northern Ireland netball international.

zh.t: 2006年全爱尔兰女子高级足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2006年全爱尔兰女子高级足球锦标赛决赛由科克队对阵阿马队。阿马半场以1比4领先0比3，但本场最佳球员诺莱格·克利里打入一球，帮助科克以1分优势获胜。这也是科克从2005年至2009年连续五次赢得全爱尔兰决赛中的第二次。阿马队球员包括北爱尔兰无挡板篮球国家队成员卡罗琳·奥汉隆。

en.s: A provincial by-election was held in Nova Scotia on 2 October 2007 to fill the vacancy in the House of Assembly riding of Cole Harbour-Eastern Passage. The byelection resulted from the resignation of New Democrat MLA Kevin Deveaux. New Democrat Becky Kent won the byelection by almost 600 votes.

zh.t: 2007年科尔港—东部通道选区补选
zh.s: 2007年10月2日，新斯科舍省举行省议会补选，以填补科尔港—东部通道选区的空缺。此次补选由新民主党议员凯文·德沃辞职引发。新民主党候选人贝基·肯特以近600票优势赢得补选。

en.t: Roh Moo-hyun crosses the Military Demarcation Line on foot for inter-Korean talks
en.s: On October 2, 2007, South Korean President Roh Moo-hyun walked across the Military Demarcation Line into North Korea. He was travelling to Pyongyang for talks with Kim Jong-il.
en.n: The crossing took place on the first day of the October 2–4 summit visit.

zh.t: 卢武铉步行越过军事分界线，前往朝鲜参加首脑会谈
zh.s: 2007年10月2日，韩国总统卢武铉步行越过军事分界线进入朝鲜，前往平壤与金正日举行首脑会谈。
zh.n: 这次访问持续至10月4日，越过军事分界线发生在首日。

en.s: MFC 22: Payoff was a mixed martial arts event held by the Maximum Fighting Championship (MFC), it was held on October 2, 2009, at the River Cree Resort and Casino in Enoch, Alberta. It featured the return of Jason MacDonald, who was competing in his first fight since being released by the UFC, against Travis Lutter, also competing in his first fight since being released by the UFC.

zh.s: MFC 22：清算战是最高格斗锦标赛（MFC）举办的综合格斗赛事，于2009年10月2日在艾伯塔省埃农的河溪度假赌场举行。杰森·麦克唐纳复出参赛，这是他离开UFC后的首场比赛，对手特拉维斯·卢特也同样在离开UFC后首次出战。

en.t: K-1 World Grand Prix 2010 in Seoul Final 16
en.s: K-1 World Grand Prix 2010 in Seoul Final 16 was a martial arts event held by the K-1 on Saturday, October 2, 2010 at the Olympic Gymnastics Arena in Seoul, Korea. It was the Final Elimination tournament for top sixteen fighters. The winners have qualified for the K-1 World Grand Prix 2010 Final held on December 11, 2010 at Yokohama Arena, Japan. The eight finalists from K-1 World Grand Prix 2009 Final were automatically qualified, except Remy Bonjasky who could not compete. The eighth spot was filled by K-1 Heavyweight champion, Keijiro Maeda then two World GP 2010 tournament winners from the Bucharest and Canberra.

zh.s: 2010年K-1世界大奖赛首尔站16强赛是K-1于2010年10月2日星期六在韩国首尔奥林匹克体操竞技场举办的武术赛事，也是16名顶尖选手参加的最终淘汰赛。胜者晋级2010年12月11日在日本横滨体育馆举行的K-1世界大奖赛决赛。2009年决赛的8名决赛选手自动获得参赛资格，但雷米·邦雅斯基无法参赛。空出的名额由K-1重量级冠军前田庆次郎递补，另有两名选手分别赢得布加勒斯特和堪培拉站的2010年大奖赛赛事后晋级。

en.s: Guerra de Empresas (2010) (Spanish for "War of the Promotions") was the first annual professional wrestling major event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), which took place on October 2, 2010 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. IWRG's Guerra de Empresas series of events all center around inter-promotional competition with tag teams representing IWRG as well as a number of other wrestling promotions represented by one or more tag teams. While wrestlers all represented their "home" promotion most had competed on IWRG events prior to this event, either through IWRG's working relationship with AAA or due to be in independent contractors and not signed exclusively with one specific wrestling promotion.

zh.s: 企业大战（2010年，西班牙语意为“推广联盟之战”）是墨西哥国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）举办的首届年度大型职业摔角赛事，于2010年10月2日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。企业大战系列以联盟间对抗为主题，IWRG及其他多家摔角联盟各派一支或多支双人组合参赛。选手代表各自的“本家”联盟；不过，多数选手此前已参加过IWRG赛事，有些是通过IWRG与AAA的合作关系参赛，有些则是自由职业摔角手，没有与任何联盟签署独家合约。

en.s: The 2010 Indian Federation Cup final was the 32nd final of the Indian Federation Cup, the top knock-out competition in India, and was contested between arch-rivals East Bengal and Mohun Bagan on 2 October 2010. East Bengal won the final 1–0, to successfully retain and claim their seventh Federation Cup title. Reisangmei Vashum scored the solitary goal for the Red and Gold brigade in the 53rd minute from Robin Singh's lay-off pass.

zh.s: 2010年印度联邦杯决赛是印度顶级淘汰制赛事印度联邦杯的第32届决赛，于2010年10月2日由宿敌东孟加拉队和莫亨巴根队交锋。东孟加拉以1比0获胜，成功卫冕并第七次夺得联邦杯。第53分钟，瓦舒姆·雷桑梅在罗宾·辛格传球后打入全场唯一进球。

en.s: The 2010 Shreveport mayoral election resulted in the re-election of incumbent Democrat Cedric Glover who defeated Republican Bryan Wooley in the runoff to win a second term in office. The nonpartisan blanket primary was held on October 2, 2010, and as no candidate obtained the required majority, the general election followed on November 2, 2010.

zh.s: 2010年什里夫波特市长选举中，民主党籍时任市长塞德里克·格洛弗击败共和党候选人布莱恩·伍利，在第二轮胜出并连任。无党派初选于2010年10月2日举行；由于无人达到所需多数，普选于11月2日举行。

en.s: Brisbane Open House (BOH) is a free annual event which allows the public to discover the architecture, engineering and history in buildings and places in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia. Selected buildings are open to the public with guided and self-guided tours encouraging visitors to explore Brisbane's built environment. The event is organised by the Queensland Government Architect, the Brisbane Development Association, and the National Trust of Queensland.
en.n: The inaugural Brisbane Open House took place on 2 October 2010, and featured 20 buildings in the CBD and South Bank.

zh.s: 布里斯班开放日（BOH）是一项免费年度活动，让公众了解澳大利亚昆士兰州布里斯班的建筑、工程和历史。部分建筑会向公众开放，并提供导览和自助参观，鼓励访客探索布里斯班的建成环境。活动由昆士兰州政府建筑师办公室、布里斯班发展协会和昆士兰州国家信托组织。首届布里斯班开放日于2010年10月2日举行，开放了中央商务区和南岸的20栋建筑。
zh.n: 首届布里斯班开放日于2010年10月2日举行，开放了中央商务区和南岸的20栋建筑。

en.s: The Igunga by-election was a by-election held for the Tanzanian parliamentary constituency of Igunga in Tabora Region. It was triggered by the resignation of Rostam Aziz, the previous Member of Parliament (MP) who had held the seat for the Chama Cha Mapinduzi since 1994. The by-election took place on 2 October 2011 and the CCM candidate won by 50.46%.

zh.s: 坦桑尼亚塔博拉区伊贡加选区举行议会补选，原因是自1994年以来代表革命党（CCM）的议员罗斯坦·阿齐兹辞职。补选于2011年10月2日举行，革命党候选人以50.46%的得票率获胜。

en.s: Hell in a Cell (2011) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by WWE and presented by WowWee's Light Strike that took place on October 2, 2011 at the New Orleans Arena in New Orleans, Louisiana. It was the third annual Hell in a Cell event. Seven matches took place at the event. The event received 182,000 pay-per-view buys, down from 210,000 buys the previous year.

zh.s: 《地狱牢笼》（2011年）是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）制作、由WowWee旗下Light Strike赞助的职业摔角付费观看赛事，于2011年10月2日在新奥尔良竞技场举行，共有七场比赛。该系列赛事至此已举办三届。赛事获得18.2万次付费观看，低于上一年的21万次。

en.s: The 2015 Uprising was the fourth Uprising professional wrestling supershow promoted by the British Revolution Pro Wrestling (RPW), in partnership with the Japanese New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) promotion. The event was held on October 2, 2015 in the York Hall in Bethnal Green, London, England. The event marked the first collaborative event held by RPW and NJPW.

zh.s: 《起义》2015是英国职业摔角联盟革命职业摔角（RPW）与日本新日本职业摔角（NJPW）合作举办的第四届《起义》超级赛事。比赛于2015年10月2日在英格兰伦敦贝斯纳尔格林的约克厅举行，也是两家联盟首次联合举办赛事。

en.s: The 2015 Afghan Premier League Final was the final match of the 2015 Afghan Premier League, the 4th season of Afghanistan's premier club football tournament organised by Roshan. The match took place on Friday, 2 October 2015, at the AFF Stadium in Kabul, Afghanistan, between Greater Kabul Region Shaheen Asmayee and Eastern region De Spin Ghar Bazan. It was the fourth tournament final since the establishment of Afghan Premier League.

zh.s: 2015年阿富汗超级联赛决赛是该项阿富汗顶级俱乐部足球赛事2015赛季的冠军决胜战，由Roshan主办。决赛于2015年10月2日星期五在阿富汗喀布尔AFF体育场举行，参赛队为大喀布尔地区的沙欣·阿斯马耶队和东部地区的德斯宾格尔巴赞队。这是阿富汗超级联赛创办以来的第四届决赛。

en.t: The 2015 CMLL Universal Championship begins its first elimination round
en.s: On October 2, 2015, the first elimination round of the CMLL Universal Championship took place at Arena México in Mexico City.
en.n: This is the first elimination round, rather than the final held on October 16.

zh.t: CMLL 2015年环球冠军赛举行首轮淘汰赛
zh.s: 2015年10月2日，CMLL环球冠军赛在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行首轮淘汰赛。
zh.n: 这一天举行的是首轮淘汰赛，决赛于10月16日举行。

en.t: Zac Goldsmith is named the Conservative candidate for London mayor
en.s: On October 2, 2015, Zac Goldsmith was announced as the Conservative Party’s candidate for the 2016 London mayoral election. He received 70.6% of the selection ballot.
en.n: This was the candidate selection result, not the election of London’s mayor.

zh.t: 扎克·戈德史密斯获提名为保守党伦敦市长候选人
zh.s: 2015年10月2日，保守党宣布扎克·戈德史密斯成为2016年伦敦市长选举候选人。他在候选人遴选投票中获得70.6%的选票。
zh.n: 这是候选人遴选结果，并非伦敦市长选举结果。

en.t: AAA holds Héroes Inmortales X in Monterrey
en.s: On October 2, 2016, AAA held its Héroes Inmortales X professional wrestling event at Arena Monterrey in Mexico. The annual show honoured the promotion’s late founder, Antonio Peña.

zh.t: AAA在蒙特雷举办Héroes Inmortales X摔角赛事
zh.s: 2016年10月2日，AAA在墨西哥蒙特雷竞技场举办Héroes Inmortales X职业摔角赛事。这项年度赛事纪念该组织已故创始人安东尼奥·佩尼亚。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Cape Verde on 2 October 2016. Incumbent President Jorge Carlos Fonseca of the Movement for Democracy (MpD) was re-elected with 74.08% of the vote.

zh.s: 佛得角于2016年10月2日举行总统选举。争取民主运动（MpD）籍现任总统若热·卡洛斯·丰塞卡以74.08%的得票率连任。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 2 October 2016 to elect mayors and assemblies in 144 municipalities and cities. A total of 3,263,906 voters were registered in the Central Voters’ Register, including 65,111 by-mail voters. Around 25,000 citizens voted at polling stations in diplomatic representations abroad. 30,000 candidates were contesting the election for 2,835 local councillors, 301 city councillors, 131 municipal mayors and 12 city majors.

zh.t: 2016年波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那地方选举
zh.s: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那于2016年10月2日举行地方选举，改选144个市镇和城市的市长及议会成员。中央选民登记册共有3,263,906名登记选民，其中包括65,111名邮寄选民。约2.5万名公民在驻外外交机构的投票站投票。共有3万名候选人角逐2835个地方议员席位、301个市议员席位、131个市镇市长职位和12个城市市长职位。

en.s: The Brazilian municipal elections of 2016 took place on 2 October 2016 and on 30 October 2016 (for cities with more than 200,000 voters, where the second round is available). Electors chose mayors, vice-mayors and city councillors of all 5,568 cities of the country. The partisan conventions took place between 20 July and 5 August. The party political broadcast started on 26 August and ended on 29 September.

zh.s: 巴西于2016年10月2日举行地方选举，部分选民超过20万的城市于10月30日举行第二轮投票。全国5568个城市的选民选出市长、副市长和市议员。各党代表大会于7月20日至8月5日举行，竞选广播于8月26日开始、9月29日结束。

en.s: The 2016 São Paulo municipal election took place in the city of São Paulo on the 2 October 2016. Voters voted to elect the Mayor, the Vice Mayor and 55 City Councillors for the administration of the city. The result was a 1st round victory for João Doria of the Brazilian Social Democratic Party (PSDB), winning 3,085,187 votes and a share of 53,28% of the popular vote, defeating incumbent mayor Fernando Haddad of the Workers' Party (PT), who took 967,190 votes and a share of 16,70% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 圣保罗市于2016年10月2日举行市政选举，选出市长、副市长和55名市议员。巴西社会民主党（PSDB）候选人若昂·多利亚在第一轮获胜，得票3,085,187张，占53.28%；他击败了工人党（PT）籍时任市长费尔南多·阿达，后者获得967,190票，占16.70%。

en.s: The 2016 Bound for Glory was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It took place on October 2, 2016, at the Impact Zone in Orlando, Florida, the first time since the inaugural 2005 event to be held at the venue. It was the twelfth event in the Bound for Glory chronology, and the last live pay-per-view event under the TNA name until the 2024 Hard To Kill event.

zh.s: 2016年《荣耀之路》是Total Nonstop Action摔角（TNA）制作的职业摔角付费观看赛事。比赛于2016年10月2日在佛罗里达州奥兰多的冲击区举行，这是自2005年首届赛事以来，赛事首次在该场馆举办。这是《荣耀之路》系列第12届赛事，也是TNA更名为影响力摔角前最后一场以TNA名义直播的付费观看赛事；直到2024年的《Hard To Kill》才再次以该名称举办。

en.s: The 2016 FA WSL Cup final was the sixth final of the FA WSL Cup, England's secondary cup competition for women's football teams and its primary league cup tournament. Manchester City defeated Birmingham 1-0 in extra time.

zh.t: 2016年英格兰女子超级联赛杯决赛
zh.s: 2016年英格兰女子超级联赛杯决赛是该项赛事的第六届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球的第二级杯赛和主要联赛杯赛。曼彻斯特城队在加时赛中以1比0击败伯明翰队。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Iraq on 2 October 2018 to elect the President of Iraq for a four-year term via indirect suffrage by the Council of Representatives. The result was a win for Barham Salih, who received 219 votes. The position is largely ceremonial, with Iraq being a parliamentary system. There were 31 candidates for the election, with only seven being approved to run.

zh.s: 伊拉克于2018年10月2日举行总统选举，由议会代表间接投票选出任期四年的总统。巴尔哈姆·萨利赫以219票胜出。伊拉克实行议会制，总统职位主要具有礼仪性质。此次选举共有31名候选人，只有7人获准参选。

en.s: On 2 October 2018, Jamal Khashoggi, a Saudi dissident journalist, was killed by agents of the Saudi government at the Saudi consulate in Istanbul, Turkey. Khashoggi was ambushed and strangled by a 15-member squad of Saudi operatives. His body was dismembered and disposed of in a manner that was never publicly revealed.

zh.s: 2018年10月2日，沙特异议记者贾迈勒·卡舒吉在土耳其伊斯坦布尔的沙特领事馆被沙特政府特工杀害。15名沙特人员埋伏并勒死了卡舒吉。他的遗体遭肢解，具体如何处置从未公开。

en.s: On October 2, 2019, a Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress privately owned by the Collings Foundation crashed at Bradley International Airport, Windsor Locks, Connecticut, United States. Seven of the thirteen people on board were killed, and the other six, as well as one person on the ground, were injured. The aircraft was destroyed by fire, with only a portion of one wing and the tail remaining.

zh.t: 2019年波音B-17空中堡垒轰炸机空难
zh.s: 2019年10月2日，一架由科林斯基金会私人拥有的波音B-17空中堡垒轰炸机在美国康涅狄格州温莎洛克斯的布拉德利国际机场坠毁。机上13人中有7人死亡，其余6人以及地面1人受伤。飞机起火烧毁，只剩下部分机翼和尾部。

en.s: The AEW Dynamite Debut episode was the pilot episode for the American television program AEW Dynamite, produced by the professional wrestling promotion of All Elite Wrestling. The show took place on October 2, 2019, and was broadcast live on TNT from the Capital One Arena in Washington, D.C. The event marked the first time a professional wrestling event aired on TNT since the final episode of WCW Monday Nitro aired on March 26, 2001.

zh.s: AEW Dynamite首播是美国电视节目《AEW Dynamite》的试播集，由职业摔角联盟精英摔角（AEW）制作。节目于2019年10月2日在华盛顿特区第一资本体育馆现场录制并通过TNT播出。这是自2001年3月26日《WCW周一硝基》最后一集播出以来，职业摔角节目首次在TNT播出。

en.s: Fightland (2021) was a professional wrestling television special produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW), which was held on October 2, 2021 and was the third event under the Fightland chronology. Matches from the event were taped for MLW programming; the main card aired as a one-hour special on October 7, 2021 on Vice TV, while other matches would air as part of the mini-series, MLW Fusion: Alpha, on MLW's YouTube channel and BeIN Sports USA.

zh.s: 《Fightland》（2021年）是美国职业摔角联盟MLW制作的电视特别节目，于2021年10月2日举行，是《Fightland》系列第三场赛事。部分比赛录像用于MLW节目；主赛于2021年10月7日在Vice TV作为一小时特别节目播出，其他比赛则作为迷你剧《MLW Fusion：Alpha》的一部分，在MLW的YouTube频道和BeIN Sports USA播出。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Santos vs. Walker
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Santos vs. Walker (also known as UFC Fight Night 193, UFC Vegas 38 and UFC on ESPN+ 51) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on October 2, 2021 at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：桑托斯对阵沃克
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：桑托斯对阵沃克又称UFC格斗之夜193、UFC维加斯38和UFC on ESPN+ 51，是终极格斗冠军赛主办的综合格斗赛事，于2021年10月2日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex场馆举行。恩特普赖斯位于拉斯维加斯都会区。

en.s: The 2021 Georgian local elections (Georgian: საქართველოს ადგილობრივი თვითმმართველობის ორგანოების არჩევნები) were held on 2 and 30 October to elect the bodies of local government of Georgia. The voters elected 2,068 representatives in the 64 municipal assemblies (sakrebulo) and 64 mayors. The ruling Georgian Dream party secured victory in all mayoral elections except that in Tsalenjikha but lost its majority in 7 out of 64 municipal assemblies.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 格鲁吉亚于2021年10月2日和30日举行地方选举，选出地方政府机构成员。选民选出64个市镇议会（sakrebulo）的2068名代表及64名市长。执政的格鲁吉亚梦想党赢得除察伦吉哈以外的所有市长选举，但失去了64个市镇议会中7个议会的多数席位。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第一轮投票日期。

en.s: The 2022 Paraná state election took place in the state of Paraná, Brazil on 2 October 2022. Voters elected a Governor, Vice Governor, one Senator, 30 representatives for the Chamber of Deputies, and 54 Legislative Assembly members. The incumbent Governor, Ratinho Júnior, of the Social Democratic Party (PSD), was reelected in the first round with 69.64% of the votes.

zh.s: 巴西巴拉那州于2022年10月2日举行州选举，选出州长、副州长、一名参议员、30名联邦众议员和54名州议会议员。社民党（PSD）籍时任州长拉蒂尼奥·儒尼奥尔在第一轮以69.64%的得票率连任。

loc: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那

en.s: General elections were held in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 2 October 2022. They decided the makeup of the presidency as well as national, entity and cantonal governments. Christian Schmidt, the High Representative for Bosnia and Herzegovina, imposed changes to the country's electoral law hours after voting ended for the election.

zh.t: 2022年波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那大选
zh.s: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那于2022年10月2日举行大选，决定主席团以及国家、实体和州级政府的组成。投票结束数小时后，该国高级代表克里斯蒂安·施密特宣布修改该国选举法。

en.s: The 2022 Bahia state election took place in the state of Bahia, Brazil on 2 October 2022. The elections saw voters choose a Governor and Vice Governor, one Senator, 39 representatives for the Chamber of Deputies, and 63 Legislative Assembly members. The incumbent Governor, Rui Costa, of the Workers' Party (PT), was not eligible for a third term since he ran for governor in 2014 and 2018.

zh.s: 巴西巴伊亚州于2022年10月2日举行州选举，选民选出州长、副州长、一名参议员、39名联邦众议员和63名州议会议员。工人党（PT）籍时任州长鲁伊·科斯塔因已于2014年和2018年竞选州长，不能竞选第三个任期。

en.s: The 2022 Minas Gerais state elections took place in the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil on 2 October 2022. Voters elected a governor, vice governor, one senator, 53 representatives for the Chamber of Deputies, and 77 Legislative Assembly members. The incumbent governor, Romeu Zema, a member of the New Party, was eligible for a second term, and intended to run for reelection.

zh.s: 巴西米纳斯吉拉斯州于2022年10月2日举行州选举，选民选出州长、副州长、一名参议员、53名联邦众议员和77名州议会议员。新党籍时任州长罗梅乌·泽马符合连任资格，并计划竞选连任。

en.s: The 2022 Open Internacional de San Sebastián was a professional tennis tournament played on outdoor clay courts. It was the first edition of the tournament which was part of the 2022 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour. It took place in San Sebastián, Spain between 26 September and 2 October 2022.

zh.t: 2022年圣塞瓦斯蒂安国际网球公开赛
zh.s: 2022年圣塞瓦斯蒂安国际网球公开赛是一项在室外红土球场举行的职业网球赛事，也是2022年ITF女子世界网球巡回赛的一站。该赛事首次举办，于2022年9月26日至10月2日在西班牙圣塞瓦斯蒂安举行。

en.s: The 2022 Pernambuco state elections took place in the state of Pernambuco, Brazil on 2 October 2022. Voters elected a governor, vice governor, one senator, 25 representatives for the Chamber of Deputies, and 49 Legislative Assembly members. Paulo Câmara, the incumbent governor of Pernambuco, was reelected in the first round in 2018 Pernambuco gubernatorial election, with 1,918,219 votes, the equivalent to 50.70% of the valid votes.

zh.s: 巴西伯南布哥州于2022年10月2日举行州选举，选民选出州长、副州长、一名参议员、25名联邦众议员和49名州议会议员。时任州长保罗·卡马拉曾在2018年选举中于第一轮连任，获得1,918,219票，相当于有效票的50.70%。

en.s: The 2022 Rio de Janeiro state election took place in the state of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil on 2 October 2022. Voters elected a governor, vice governor, one senator, two alternate senator, 46 representatives for the Chamber of Deputies, and 70 Legislative Assembly members, with a possible second round to be held on 30 October 2022.

zh.s: 巴西里约热内卢州于2022年10月2日举行州选举，选民选出州长、副州长、一名参议员、两名候补参议员、46名联邦众议员和70名州议会议员。若无人获得过半选票，第二轮投票将于2022年10月30日举行。

en.t: 2022 Mato Grosso do Sul gubernatorial election
en.s: The 2022 Mato Grosso do Sul state election took place in the state of Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil between 2 October 2022 (first round) and 30 October 2022 (second round). Voters elected a governor, vice governor, a senator, 8 representatives for the Chamber of Deputies of Brazil (federal deputies) and 24 Legislative Assembly members (state deputies).

zh.t: 2022年南马托格罗索州州长选举
zh.s: 巴西南马托格罗索州于2022年10月2日举行第一轮州选举，第二轮于10月30日举行。选民选出州长、副州长、一名参议员、8名联邦众议员和24名州议会议员。

en.s: Municipal and regional elections in Peru were held on Sunday, 2 October 2022, electing authorities for the period 2023–2026. Since 2018, municipal and regional officials cannot serve consecutive terms.

zh.s: 秘鲁于2022年10月2日星期日举行地方和地区选举，选出2023至2026年任期的官员。自2018年起，地方和地区官员不得连续任职。

en.s: Gubernatorial elections were held in Brazil on 2 October 2022 as part of the nationwide general elections to elect tickets with state governors and their vice governors (as well as the Governor of the Federal District and their vice governor). A second round was held on 30 October for states where no candidate was able to secure more than half of the votes in the first round.

zh.s: 巴西于2022年10月2日举行州长选举，作为全国大选的一部分，选出各州及联邦区的州长和副州长。若第一轮没有候选人获得过半选票，则相关州于10月30日举行第二轮投票。

en.s: The 2022 Lima municipal election were held on 2 October 2022, following the convening of regional and municipal elections throughout Peru. Lima residents voted on a list of 40 candidates to replace incumbent Miguel Romero Sotelo whose term ended on 31 December 2022, alongside 39 metropolitan councilpeople. Rafael López Aliaga, leader of Popular Renewal, would be elected mayor of the Lima municipality.

zh.s: 秘鲁于2022年10月2日举行利马市政选举。利马居民在40名候选人中选出接替时任市长米格尔·罗梅罗·索特洛的人选；他的任期于2022年12月31日结束。选民还选出39名大都会议会议员。人民复兴党领袖拉斐尔·洛佩斯·阿利亚加当选利马市长。

en.s: The 2022 São Paulo state election took place in the state of São Paulo, Brazil on 2 October 2022 and 30 October 2022 (second round, if necessary). Voters elected a Governor, Vice Governor, one Senator, 70 representatives for the Chamber of Deputies, and 94 Legislative Assembly members. The incumbent Governor, Rodrigo Garcia, of the Brazilian Social Democracy Party (PSDB), was eligible for a second term and ran for reelection.

zh.s: 巴西圣保罗州于2022年10月2日举行州选举；如有需要，第二轮于10月30日举行。选民选出州长、副州长、一名参议员、70名联邦众议员和94名州议会议员。巴西社会民主党（PSDB）籍时任州长罗德里戈·加西亚符合连任资格，并参加竞选。

en.s: The 2022 Maranhão gubernatorial election took place in the state of Maranhão, Brazil on 2 October 2022, as part of the 2022 Brazilian general election in the Federal District and the 26 states. Voters will elect a Governor, Vice Governor, one Senator, two Alternate Senators, 18 representatives for the Chamber of Deputies, and 42 Legislative Assembly members.

zh.s: 巴西马拉尼昂州于2022年10月2日举行州选举，作为巴西联邦区和26个州全国大选的一部分。选民将选出州长、副州长、一名参议员、两名候补参议员、18名联邦众议员和42名州议会议员。

en.s: The 2022 Santa Catarina state election took place in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil on 2 October 2022 and 30 October 2022. Voters elected a Governor, Vice Governor, one Senator, 16 representatives for the Chamber of Deputies and 40 Legislative Assembly members. The incumbent Governor, Carlos Moisés, of the Republicans, was eligible for a second term and ran for reelection.

zh.s: 巴西圣卡塔琳娜州于2022年10月2日和30日举行州选举，选出州长、副州长、一名参议员、16名联邦众议员和40名州议会议员。共和党籍时任州长卡洛斯·莫伊塞斯符合连任资格，并参加竞选。

en.t: 2022 Rio Grande do Sul gubernatorial election
en.s: The 2022 Rio Grande do Sul state election took place in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil on 2 October 2022. Voters elected a Governor, Vice Governor, one Senator, 31 representatives for the Chamber of Deputies and 55 Legislative Assembly members, with a possible second round to be held on 30 October 2022. Former governor Eduardo Leite, was eligible for a second term and announced that he's running for reelection.

zh.t: 2022年南里奥格兰德州州长选举
zh.s: 巴西南里奥格兰德州于2022年10月2日举行州选举，选出州长、副州长、一名参议员、31名联邦众议员和55名州议会议员。如有需要，第二轮将于10月30日举行。前州长爱德华多·莱特符合连任资格，并宣布参选。

en.s: The 2022 Central Coast Pro Tennis Open was a professional tennis tournament played on outdoor hard courts. It was the fourth edition of the tournament which was part of the 2022 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour. It took place in Templeton, California, United States between 26 September and 2 October 2022.

zh.t: 2022年中央海岸职业网球公开赛
zh.s: 2022年中央海岸职业网球公开赛是一项在室外硬地球场举行的职业网球赛事，属于2022年ITF女子世界网球巡回赛，是该赛事第4届。比赛于2022年9月26日至10月2日在美国加利福尼亚州坦普尔顿举行。

en.s: General elections were held in Republika Srpska on 2 October 2022 as part of the Bosnian general elections. Voters decided the President of Republika Srpska and the 83 members of the National Assembly of Republika Srpska. Incumbent president Željka Cvijanović was eligible to run for a second four-year term, but opted not to do so, instead deciding to run for Serb member of the Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

zh.s: 作为波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那大选的一部分，塞族共和国于2022年10月2日举行大选。选民选出塞族共和国总统及国民议会83名议员。时任总统热莉卡·茨维亚诺维奇虽符合竞选连任第二个四年任期的资格，却决定不再参选，转而竞选波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那主席团的塞族成员。

en.s: 2022 Canton 10 parliamentary election was held on 2 October 2022 in Canton 10, a federal unit of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, an entity of Bosnia and Herzegovina, where the voters elected all of the 25 members of the Assembly of Canton 10. The election was part of the 2022 Bosnian general election.

zh.s: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那联邦的第十州于2022年10月2日举行议会选举。选民选出州议会全部25名议员。此次选举是2022年波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那大选的一部分。

en.s: The 2022 Espírito Santo gubernatorial election occurred on 2 October 2022 and elected the Governor and Vice Governor of the state and members for the 30 seats of the Legislative Assembly. After the previous election, incumbent Governor Renato Casagrande was eligible for a second consecutive term, making a rematch with former member of the Chamber of Deputies, Carlos Manato (PL).

zh.s: 巴西圣埃斯皮里图州于2022年10月2日举行州选举，选出州长、副州长及州立法议会30名议员。上届选举后，时任州长雷纳托·卡萨格兰德符合连任第二个连续任期的资格，因而可能再次与众议院前议员、自由党（PL）候选人卡洛斯·马纳托对决。

en.s: The 2022 Federal District election was held on 2 October as part of the 2022 Brazilian general election. The district electors able to vote in a Governor and Vice Governor, one Senator, 8 members for the Chamber of Deputies and 24 members for the Legislative Chamber. The Governor and Vice Governor elected in this election will have a longer term.

zh.s: 作为2022年巴西大选的一部分，联邦区于10月2日举行选举。选民选出州长、副州长、一名参议员、8名联邦众议员和24名立法议会议员。此次选出的州长和副州长任期较长。

en.s: The 2022 Alagoas state elections were held on October 2 (first round, for all positions) and October 30 (second round, for governor), as part of the general elections in Brazil. Eligible voters elected the governor and vice governor of the state and one senator with two alternates, as well as nine federal deputies and 27 state deputies.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 作为巴西大选的一部分，阿拉戈阿斯州于2022年10月2日举行第一轮选举，所有职位均在第一轮投票；州长第二轮于10月30日举行。选民选出州长、副州长、一名参议员及两名候补参议员、9名联邦众议员和27名州议会议员。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第一轮投票日期。

en.s: The 2022 Iraqi Super Cup was the 11th edition of the Iraqi Super Cup. It was held on 2 October 2022 between the 2021–22 Iraqi Premier League champions Al-Shorta and the 2021–22 Iraq FA Cup winners Al-Karkh at Al-Madina Stadium. Al-Shorta made their third appearance in the Super Cup while Al-Karkh made their first appearance. Al-Shorta won the match 1–0 with a goal from Abdoul Madjid Moumouni to clinch their second Super Cup title.

zh.s: 2022年伊拉克超级杯是该项赛事第11届，于2022年10月2日举行。2021—2022赛季伊拉克足球超级联赛冠军警察俱乐部对阵伊拉克杯冠军卡尔克俱乐部，比赛在麦地那体育场进行。警察俱乐部第三次参加超级杯，卡尔克俱乐部则是首次参赛。警察俱乐部以1比0获胜，阿卜杜勒·马吉德·穆穆尼打入制胜球，帮助球队第二次夺冠。

en.s: The 2022 Ceara Gubernatorial election was held in the state of Ceará, Brazil on Sunday 2 October. Voters elected the President and Vice President of the Republic, a Governor, Vice Governor of the State and a Senator of the Republic with two alternates, in addition to 22 Federal Deputies and 46 State Deputies.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 塞阿拉州于2022年10月2日星期日举行州长选举，作为巴西大选的一部分。选民选出巴西总统和副总统、州长和副州长、一名参议员及两名候补参议员、22名联邦众议员和46名州议会议员。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第一轮投票日期。

en.s: On 2 October 2023, over 60 Nigerien soldiers were killed in the village of Tabatol, Niger. The soldiers had been reinforcing a Nigerien outpost that had been attacked by the Islamic State – Sahil Province (ISGS) earlier in the day, and the reinforcements were attacked a second time by over 100 militants from the Islamic State's Sahel Province, who used IEDs and "kamikaze vehicles".

zh.s: 2023年10月2日，尼日尔塔巴托尔村有60多名士兵遇害。当天早些时候，一处尼日尔前哨据点遭伊斯兰国萨赫勒省（ISGS）袭击，士兵前往增援，随后又遭100多名圣战分子袭击。袭击者使用了简易爆炸装置和“自杀式车辆”。

en.s: The 2023 Finnish Sámi parliamentary election took place between 4 September and 2 October 2023 to elect 21 members and four deputy members to the Sámi Parliament of Finland. On 27 March 2024, the Supreme Administrative Court of Finland ruled that the election had been conducted unlawfully due to the exclusion of 72 individuals from the electoral register, despite their eligibility as determined by prior court rulings.

zh.s: 芬兰于2023年9月4日至10月2日举行萨米议会选举，选出21名议员和4名候补议员。2024年3月27日，芬兰最高行政法院裁定此次选举违法，因为72人虽根据此前法院判决符合资格，却被排除在选民名册之外。

en.s: A by-election was held on October 2, 2023, in the provincial riding of Jean-Talon in Quebec. This was triggered following the resignation of CAQ MNA Joëlle Boutin. The Parti Québécois candidate Pascal Paradis won the election. The PQ win is notable for two reasons: PQ had never before won the riding of Jean-Talon and this also marked their first win at a by-election since 2016.

zh.s: 魁北克省让-塔隆选区于2023年10月2日举行补选。此次补选因魁北克未来联盟（CAQ）省议员若埃尔·布丹辞职而举行。魁北克人党候选人帕斯卡尔·帕拉迪斯获胜。这一胜利有两点特别之处：魁北克人党此前从未赢得让-塔隆选区，也自2016年以来首次赢得补选。

en.t: A Malian military convoy leaves Gao toward the Kidal region
en.s: On October 2, 2023, a large Malian military convoy left Gao and headed north toward the Kidal region.
en.n: The convoy’s departure preceded the later capture of Kidal.

zh.t: 马里军方车队从加奥出发，向基达尔地区进发
zh.s: 2023年10月2日，一支马里军方大型车队离开加奥，向北驶往基达尔地区。
zh.n: 车队启程在前，军方后来才控制基达尔。

en.t: The 29th Busan International Film Festival opens
en.s: On October 2, 2024, the 29th Busan International Film Festival opened at the Busan Cinema Center in South Korea. The opening film was Uprising, directed by Kim Sang-man.
en.n: The festival continued through October 11; screenings across the programme did not all take place on opening day.

zh.t: 第29届釜山国际电影节开幕
zh.s: 2024年10月2日，第29届釜山国际电影节在韩国釜山电影中心开幕，开幕影片是金尚满执导的《战，乱》。
zh.n: 电影节持续至10月11日，各单元影片并非都在开幕当天放映。

en.t: The 16th DMZ International Documentary Film Festival holds its closing ceremony
en.s: On October 2, 2024, the 16th DMZ International Documentary Film Festival held its closing ceremony in Goyang, South Korea. The ceremony included award presentations and the official close of the festival.
en.n: The festival had opened on September 26.

zh.t: 第16届DMZ国际纪录片电影节举行闭幕式
zh.s: 2024年10月2日，第16届DMZ国际纪录片电影节在韩国高阳市举行闭幕式，颁发奖项并正式闭幕。
zh.n: 本届电影节于9月26日开幕。

en.s: On 2 October 2025, during the Jewish holiday of Yom Kippur, a man drove a black Kia Picanto into pedestrians before stabbing worshippers at the Heaton Park Hebrew Congregation, a synagogue in Higher Crumpsall, a northern suburb of the city of Manchester in North West England. Two people were killed in the incident, Adrian Daulby, aged 53 and Melvin Cravitz, aged 66.

zh.t: 2025年曼彻斯特犹太会堂袭击案
zh.s: 2025年10月2日犹太赎罪日当天，一名男子驾驶黑色起亚Picanto冲撞行人，随后持刀袭击礼拜者。袭击地点是英国西北英格兰曼彻斯特北郊高克鲁姆斯索尔的希顿公园希伯来会堂。事件造成两人死亡：53岁的阿德里安·多尔比和66岁的梅尔文·克拉维茨。

en.s: Municipal elections in Newfoundland and Labrador were held on October 2, 2025. Voters in the Canadian province of Newfoundland and Labrador elected mayors, councillors, and all other elected officials in all of the province's municipalities and local service districts. Municipal elections in the province are non-partisan. In 2024, the date of the election was changed from September 30, 2025 to avoid clashing with the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation.

zh.s: 第29届釜山国际电影节于2024年10月2日在釜山电影殿堂开幕，开幕影片是金相满执导的韩国电影《起义》。电影节共展映来自63个国家的278部影片，其中224部为官方邀请影片，另有54场社区“beef”放映。开幕式由朴宝英和安宰弘主持。伊朗导演穆罕默德·拉索罗夫获选担任竞赛单元“新浪潮”评审团主席。
